title: Task Scheduler
description: Given a list of tasks and a cooldown n, find the minimum time to complete all tasks.
pseudocode:
1. freq = count frequencies of tasks
2. maxFreq = max(freq)
3. idleCount = (maxFreq - 1) * n
4. for each f in freq excluding maxFreq: idleCount -= min(maxFreq - 1, f)
5. return tasks.length + max(0, idleCount)

steps.note: Calculate initial idle slots based on cooldown n=2: (2-1) * 2 = 2
Subtract frequencies of other tasks: 2 - min(1, 1) = 1 idle slot remaining
